title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 4:1-11
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 4:1-11</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="4:1" /> Then Iesous was led into the wilderness by <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the spirit</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">to be tested</char> by <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">the slanderer</char>,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Test 1" indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="2" /> and having <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">fasted</char> forty days and forty nights,
        </group>
        <group>
          afterward he was <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">hungry</char>,
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="3" /> and approaching, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">the tester</char> said to him,
        </group>
        <group>
          “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">If you are the son of God</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          speak so that these stones become <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">loaves of bread</char>.”
        </group>
      </group>
      <group title="Deuteronomy 8:3" indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="4" /> And responding, he said,
        </group>
        <group>
          “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">It has been written</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          ‘Not by <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">bread</char> alone does humanity live,
        </group>
        <group>
          but by every word that comes out from God’s mouth.’”
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Test 2" indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="5" /> Then <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">the slanderer</char> took him into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">the holy city</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          and he stationed him at the upper tip of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">the temple</char>,
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="6" /> and he said to him,
        </group>
        <group>
          “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">If you are the son of God</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          throw yourself down,
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">for it has been written</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          ‘He has commanded his <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">messengers</char> concerning you,
        </group>
        <group>
          and they will lift you up in their hands,
        </group>
        <group>
          so that you won’t strike your foot against a stone.’”
        </group>
      </group>
      <group title="Deuteronomy 6:16" indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="7" /> Iesous said to him,
        </group>
        <group>
          “Again, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">it has been written</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          ‘You will not <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">test</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the Lord your God</char>.’”
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Test 3" indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A''" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="8" /> Again, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">the slanderer</char> took him to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">a high mountain</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          and he showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor,
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B''" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="9" /> and he said to him,
        </group>
        <group>
          “All these things I will give to you,
        </group>
        <group>
          if, falling down, you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">bow down</char> to me.”
        </group>
      </group>
      <group title="Deuteronomy 6:13" indent="3" sidebar-value="C''" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="10" /> Then Iesous said to him,
        </group>
        <group>
          “Be gone, adversary!
        </group>
        <group>
          For <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">it has been written</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          ‘You will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">bow down</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the Lord your God</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          and you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">serve</char> him only.’”
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="11" /> Then <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">the slanderer</char> left him,
      </group>
      <group>
        and look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">messengers</char> approached and ministered to him.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
